background.prompt: A bright coastal morning seen from just above the water: a clear blue sky with soft clouds filling the top half, a calm sparkling blue sea filling the bottom half with a few gentle waves, the water in the foreground clear enough to see a little way down. Completely EMPTY: no birds, no fish, no boats. Keep the sky at the centre and the water at the centre clear.

dolphin.prompt: A friendly grey-blue dolphin leaping in an arc to the right, big gentle eye, smiling, in the same soft layered cutout illustration style as the reference image. Whole dolphin, centred, on a flat solid bright green background (#00ff00), no floor, no cast shadow, no other objects.
